promotion.min_settled_bets_justification: Exact binomial: 210 settled bets is the smallest n at which a true 60% forecaster is detected against 50% at two-sided alpha 0.05 with 80% power. A one-sided criterion would need 158; the stricter two-sided number is used because the leaderboard publishes many strategies and a two-sided floor cannot be gamed by only counting the good tail.
promotion.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.10 across the registered family
promotion.forward_record: at least 4 consecutive weeks graded after the parameters were frozen
promotion.price_required: an opening AND closing number per bet, from a registered licensed source

demotion.reentry_rule: a demoted strategy may not be re-promoted until it clears the full promotion gate again on data collected entirely after the demotion date
demotion.asymmetry_note: demotion needs one condition; promotion needs all of them

family.multiplicity_control: Holm-Bonferroni at family level, applied to the signal p-values
family.why_no_staking_column: Staking return needs a price. No price exists (see the price store), so the column is blank and the strategy cannot be scored on money. That is precisely what stops a lucky staking run from masking a bad signal: there is no staking column to run.

demotion_drill.synthetic: yes — these series are constructed fixtures used to prove the gate fires, not results from any strategy

rows.case: signal decays to a coin flip over a long sample
rows.reasons: signal decays to p = 0.940 over 300 settled bets, i.e. indistinguishable from a coin flip at the published threshold

rows.case: bankroll drawdown beyond the published cap
six consecutive losing weeks with a still-good long-run signal
marked live with no priced bet, so it cannot be scored at all
rows.reasons: strategy is marked live but has no priced bet in the store: an unpriced live strategy cannot be scored and must return to paper

rows.case: healthy control: good signal, small sample, no drawdown, no streak
short sample is exempt from the signal check, so a small bad run does not demote

asymmetry: Promotion requires every condition; demotion requires any one. The rule is stated once here and applied to every row on the leaderboard.
